catalogMeta.label: Solve Story (Scaffold 3)
catalogMeta.description: Solve a word problem and SAY the answer out loud. The unknown may be the result, the change, or the start (AXIS 2). Unaided spoken production at both grades — no numeral menu and no keyboard.

fullData.title: Sunny Day Math Adventures

challenges.instruction: Listen to the story and count along with the ducks in the pond!
challenges.storyText: 3 little ducks are swimming in the pond. 2 more ducks join them.

challenges.instruction: Help out on the farm and find out how many apples we have!
challenges.storyText: 4 red apples are resting on the table. 3 more apples are placed beside them.

challenges.instruction: Let us count the hopping frogs in the garden!
challenges.storyText: 6 green frogs are sitting on a big log. 2 frogs hop away into the grass.

challenges.instruction: Time for a kitchen treat! Let us count the yummy cookies.
challenges.storyText: 5 warm cookies are cooling on a tray. 2 cookies are eaten by a hungry puppy.

challenges.instruction: Fly up to the sky and count the bright stars!
challenges.storyText: 4 bright stars are shining in the night sky. 4 more stars blink on.

challenges.instruction: Play on the playground and count the bouncy bunnies!
challenges.storyText: 7 fluffy bunnies are hopping on the playground grass. 3 bunnies hop back into their burrow.

fullData.description: Engaging addition and subtraction word problems for kindergarten students using relatable objects and themes.
